notes.title: I Love Finding Cats and Pups - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Say hello to I Love Finding Cats & Pups! Prepare to embark on a heartwarming journey filled with feline and canine cuteness. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44260921/b934bddf7934ae86631ed74c3ffd52b99796e644.gif[/img]

Embark on a heartwarming journey as you explore charming locations, searching for hidden objects amidst a delightful backdrop of fluffy companions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44260921/e371b2a1b929bc30365e1d67de27a3909f933748.gif[/img]

Adopt your furry companions, solve captivating puzzles and face thrilling challenges that will put your problem-solving skills to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44260921/b8738f60ccced897777db94027863a67df9be59b.gif[/img]

We're offering an exclusive 20% discount during the first week of the game's release on Steam. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to dive into an enchanting world of furry delight!
